guidedUnits.title: C, Am, F & Steady Down-Strums (Beginner)
guidedUnits.goal: Build clean fingertip posture, lock onto a steady 4/4 pulse, and finish your first 3-chord worship song.

guidedUnits.title: G Major, Waltz 3/4, Island Groove & Hymns
guidedUnits.goal: Conquer the 3-finger G triangle, switch smoothly between C–F–G, and master the Island & Waltz strums.

guidedUnits.badge: 🎼 Unit 3 · Expressive Minors, Key of G & Split Bars
guidedUnits.title: Dm, Em, D, A, G7/E7 & Fast 2-Chord Bars (Intermediate)
guidedUnits.goal: Break out of the Key of C into Key of G, add soulful minor & 7th chords, and handle split-bar changes.

guidedUnits.title: Keherwa 8-Beat, Dadra 6/8 & Bhajan Progressions
guidedUnits.goal: Master authentic tabla-inspired Keherwa and Dadra grooves for Hindi & Marathi gospel worship.

guidedUnits.title: Finger Strength, Bb, Bm, Key of D & Percussive Chucks
guidedUnits.goal: Clear the Intermediate-to-Advanced barre wall (Bb & Bm), play in Key of D, and drive live rhythm with chucks.

guidedUnits.title: Scales, Arpeggios, Travis Picking & 3-Key Transposition
guidedUnits.goal: Add melodic phrasing, fingerpicking accompaniment, and real-time transposition for leading worship.

chords.title: C Major Mastery
chords.desc: Ring finger on A-string Fret 3. Keep thumb centered behind the neck.
chords.tip: Curve your ring finger so the open E-string rings cleanly without buzzing.

chords.title: A Minor (Am) Mastery
chords.desc: Middle finger on G-string Fret 2. One-finger warm minor chord.
chords.tip: Keep your middle finger arched high over the C-string so all 4 strings ring.

chords.title: F Major Mastery
chords.desc: Index on E-Fret 1, Middle on G-Fret 2. Essential worship chord.
chords.tip: Keep your index fingertip vertical so the open A-string rings clearly.

chords.title: G Major Triangle
chords.tip: Tuck your elbow in slightly so your ring finger lands cleanly on E-string Fret 3.

chords.title: D Minor & E Minor
chords.desc: Practice Dm (2-2-1-0) and Em (0-4-3-2) for expressive worship ballads.
chords.tip: For Em, build a staircase from A-Fret 2 up to C-Fret 4.

chords.title: D Major & A Major (Keys of G/D)
chords.desc: Stack 3 fingers on Fret 2 for D (2-2-2-0), and open A (2-1-0-0) cleanly.
chords.tip: Angle your hand slightly toward the headstock so all 3 fingers fit inside Fret 2 for D.

chords.title: G7 & E7 Turnaround Chords
chords.desc: Classic gospel turnarounds: G7 (0-2-1-2) and E7 (1-2-0-2) pull strongly back home.
chords.tip: Anchor your index finger on Fret 1 first for both G7 and E7.

transitions.title: C ↔ Am Smooth Switch
transitions.desc: Alternate 1-finger C and Am every bar with zero pause between beats.
transitions.tip: Keep your hand relaxed; switch fingers right on the '&' of beat 4.

transitions.title: C ↔ F Worship Switch
transitions.desc: The #1 chord change in hymns & gospel songs. Nail clean F landings.
transitions.tip: Hover your index finger over E-Fret 1 during beat 4 before lifting your ring finger.

transitions.title: C ↔ G Anchor Switch
transitions.desc: Use your ring finger on Fret 3 as a pivot from A-string to E-string.
transitions.tip: Slide your ring finger from A-3 straight across to E-3—never lift your whole hand away.

transitions.title: F ↔ G Challenge
transitions.desc: Smoothly jump between F (2-0-1-0) and G (0-2-3-2) without breaking rhythm.
transitions.tip: Move your middle finger down one string (G-2 to C-2) as your guide anchor.

transitions.title: C → G → Am → F Anthem
transitions.desc: The universal worship progression used in 100+ songs in QCoach.
transitions.tip: Notice Am to F only requires adding your index finger on E-Fret 1—leave middle finger down!

transitions.title: Key of G Loop (G → D → Em → C)
transitions.desc: The #2 most common worship key—essential for singing higher-range hymns.
transitions.tip: Keep your index finger near Fret 2 as a bridge between G, D, and Em.

transitions.title: Split-Bar Changes (2 Chords/Bar)
transitions.desc: Switch chords every 2 beats (C|G → Am|F)—the key bridge into intermediate songs.
transitions.tip: Count '1 - 2 &' on the first chord, then land cleanly on Beat 3 for the second chord.

transitions.title: Am → G → F → E7 Bhajan
transitions.desc: Classic minor progression for Hindi & Marathi bhajans (Mann Aikena, Yeshu Naam).
transitions.tip: Keep your strum wrist loose for the Keherwa off-beat accent on beat 3.

transitions.title: Key of D Loop (D → A → Bm → G)
transitions.desc: Bright congregational key combining D, A, and the Bm full barre.
transitions.tip: Roll your index finger slightly onto its bony side edge so Bm rings clearly.

strumming.title: All-Down Metronome Lock
strumming.desc: Hold C Major and lock every down-strum squarely on Beats 1–2–3–4.
strumming.tip: Strum over the sweet spot where the neck meets the body for warm nylon tone.

strumming.title: 3/4 Worship Waltz
strumming.desc: D - D U D U (1 - 2 & 3 &) for Amazing Grace & traditional Catholic hymns.
strumming.tip: Accent Beat 1 slightly stronger, then keep Beats 2 & 3 light and flowing.

strumming.title: Island / Calypso Groove
strumming.desc: D - D U - U D U on C–G–Am–F. Keep your right hand swinging steadily.
strumming.tip: Never stop your strumming hand on the silent beat 3—ghost-strum downward in the air!

strumming.title: Keherwa Worship (8-Beat)
strumming.desc: D - D U X U D U — authentic Indian gospel groove with crisp chuck on beat 3.
strumming.tip: Mute the strings lightly with the edge of your palm on the X chuck for tabla-like snap.

strumming.title: 6/8 Dadra Rolling Groove
strumming.desc: D - D U D U in 6/8 for Khrist Guru Mauli, Kiti God, & Living Sacrifice.
strumming.tip: Feel two big pulses per bar (1-2-3, 4-5-6) rather than six stiff beats.

strumming.title: Dadra 6/8 Chuck Accent
strumming.desc: D - D U X U in 6/8 — adds a lively dholak snap on beat 5.
strumming.tip: Keep the X chuck crisp and light so the gentle 6/8 sway never rushes.

strumming.title: Percussive Island Chuck
strumming.desc: Master crisp muted chucks (X) on beats 2 & 4 for live group leadership.
strumming.tip: Drop your palm onto the strings at the exact split-second your index fingernail strikes.

strumming.title: Driving 16th Worship Energy
strumming.desc: D U X U D U X U — high-energy praise groove for upbeat choruses.
strumming.tip: Stay loose in the wrist—use small, brisk strokes instead of swinging your whole elbow.

warmup.title: 1-2-3-4 Finger Stretch Warm-Up
warmup.desc: Wake up all four fretting fingers with clean slow changes across open & 3-finger shapes.
warmup.tip: Press just behind each metal fret wire—never right on top of it—for zero buzz.

warmup.title: Clean-Fret Arpeggio Buzz Check
warmup.desc: Pick every string individually (C-E-G-A) to expose any muted or buzzing finger.
warmup.tip: If a string thuds instead of ringing, curl your knuckle more vertically over the fretboard.

warmup.title: Bb Partial-Barre Mastery (3-2-1-1)
warmup.desc: Flatten your index pad across E & A strings at Fret 1—the #1 gateway barre chord.
warmup.tip: Pull your elbow gently toward your ribs and place your thumb directly behind Fret 1.

warmup.title: Bm Full-Barre Mastery (4-2-2-2)
warmup.desc: Full index barre across Fret 2 with ring finger on G-Fret 4. Unlocks Key of D.
warmup.tip: Roll your index finger slightly sideways toward the nut—the bony edge needs half the pressure.

warmup.title: Barre Endurance Flow (F → Bb → C → F)
warmup.desc: Build hand stamina switching smoothly in and out of Bb without cramping.
warmup.tip: Release thumb squeeze for a split second during every chord switch so your hand stays fresh.

scales.title: C Major Scale (Do-Re-Mi)
scales.desc: Pluck single notes cleanly across C, E, and A strings in Melody View.
scales.tip: Use your thumb for C/E strings and index finger for the A-string.

scales.title: Worship Pentatonic Melody
scales.desc: Build finger independence and pitch accuracy for hymn melodies.
scales.tip: Let each note ring smoothly until the next subdivision dot lights up.

scales.title: 4-String Worship Arpeggio
scales.desc: C-E-G-A-C-E-A-E fingerpicking pattern for reflective prayer songs.
scales.tip: Assign Thumb to G/C, Index to E, and Middle finger to A so your hand stays steady.

scales.title: Travis / PIMA Fingerpicking
scales.desc: Alternating thumb-and-finger flow (C-E-G-E-A-E-G-E) for acoustic worship intros.
scales.tip: Anchor your pinky gently on the soundboard below the A-string for steady spacing.

earkeys.title: Same Song, 3 Keys (C → G → D)
earkeys.desc: Play the classic I–V–vi–IV progression seamlessly across Key of C, Key of G, and Key of D.
earkeys.tip: Listen to how the emotional color stays identical even as the pitch shifts up to fit any singer!

earkeys.title: Major vs. Minor Ear Contrast
earkeys.desc: Alternate bright Major chords with their relative Minors (C↔Am, F↔Dm, G↔Em) and hear the mood shift.
earkeys.tip: Notice how each Major chord sounds bright/open while its relative Minor feels reflective.

songs.title: Milestone 1: This Little Light of Mine
songs.desc: Score ≥75% with steady 4/4 strumming and clean beginner chord switches.
songs.tip: Keep your right hand steady on every beat—focus on crisp C and F landings.

songs.title: Milestone 2: Amazing Grace
songs.desc: Score ≥75% in 3/4 Waltz using C, F, and G with live mic listening.
songs.tip: Focus on smooth C → F → G transitions right on Beat 1.

songs.title: Milestone 3: Here I Am, Lord
songs.desc: Score ≥75% with expressive minor chords and smooth verse-to-chorus flow.
songs.tip: Let the gentle swell breathe on the verses, then open up on the refrain.

songs.title: Milestone 4: Khrist Guru Mauli
songs.desc: Rev. Narayan Vaman Tilak 6/8 Dadra mastery with live listening.
songs.tip: Lock into the gentle 6/8 Dadra sway—feel two big pulses per bar.

songs.title: Milestone 5: In Christ Alone
songs.desc: Dynamic worship anthem testing barre confidence and steady rhythmic control.
songs.tip: Keep your transitions quiet and controlled as the dynamics build.

songs.title: Milestone 6: Days of Elijah
songs.desc: Full leadership exam: driving rhythm, clean switches, and high energy at 92 BPM.
songs.tip: Nail the driving chuck energy on the chorus without rushing the tempo.

songs.title: Bonus Hindi Exam: Aradhana (Yeshu Tera Naam)
songs.desc: Master the joyful Keherwa 8-beat groove on a beloved Hindi worship anthem.
songs.tip: Highlight the Keherwa chuck on beat 3 for authentic congregational feel.
